# Product Categories (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Product Categories` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-category) | `GET /ref/category?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-category) | `POST /ref/category` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-category) | `PUT /ref/category` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-category) | `DELETE /ref/category?ID={ID}` |


Product Category CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Product Category
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         |          |Required for PUT, Ignored for POST operations          |
| `Name`  | String             | 50        | Yes         |Category name for product          |

## Product Category

Path: `/ref/category`

<a id="get-ref-category"></a>
### GET /ref/category?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Name` (optional): Only return product category that start with the specific name

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 5,
  "Page": 1,
  "CategoryList": [
    {
      "ID": "c783373b-67b1-496f-96d9-4b3ed76cb391",
      "Name": "Angry and reactive"
    },
    {

      "Name": "Apparel"
    },
    {
      "ID": "a4d910fe-c961-4499-a93c-98134a12113d",
      "Name": "ART"
    },
    {
      "ID": "4ad69777-cf5b-4515-9d87-31953566c655",

    },
    {
      "ID": "4f6f9821-99c0-4827-964c-cdd1208273e5",
      "Name": "Audiobooks"
    }
  ]
}
```
